title: Prince Harry speaks about social media

paragraphs: During a visit to the European Parliament in Brussels, Prince Harry delivered a powerful speech condemning social media platforms for exposing children to online harassment, bullying, and mental health risks.

The Duke of Sussex described short-form content and platform algorithms as brainwashing on an extraordinary scale and advocated for stricter digital regulation. At the same time, he pointed out audience members who were scrolling on their phones during his address, and urged them to consider the real-world harm inflicted on vulnerable youth. Harry backed the proposed EU Kids Act, which aims to hold tech platforms accountable rather than placing the burden entirely on parents. Accompanied by Meghan Markle who attended briefly following recent difficult personal news the couple met with lawmakers and supported grieving families who lost children to online harm.
EU leaders praised their advocacy, and promised to introduce strict age verification, restrict addictive features, and fine non-compliant platforms.

paragraphs: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle visited the European Parliament in Brussels to support new rules for protecting children online.

Prince Harry spoke to EU politicians and warned that social media companies are hurting young people through addictive apps and online bullying. He pointed out that many people in the audience were checking their phones while he was speaking.

Harry supported the new EU Kids Act, which wants social media companies to take responsibility for keeping kids safe online. Meghan joined Harry to view a memorial for young people who died because of online harm. She didn’t give a speech though. European leaders thanked them and promised to continue making internet rules safer for children.

paragraphs: Prince Harry visited Brussels. He speaks in the European Parliament about children and online world.

Harry says that social media apps are dangerous for children. They cause bad problems like bullying. He tells leaders that looking at phones all day is bad for kids. Some leaders are looking into their phones while he is speaking. Harry wants social media companies to follow strict rules to keep young people safe.
Meghan comes with Harry. They meet families of children who die because of social media. EU leaders say that Harry is right. They want to make the internet safer for all children.
